The 3-step version for easier access in and out of the water, and it has exceeded my expectations. The wider steps make a huge difference compared to many boat ladders that use narrow round rungs. Climbing out of the water feels much more comfortable and secure, especially barefoot. The ladder is solid, and the stainless steel construction is well made. I like that it folds and telescopes up when not in use, keeping it out of the water and out of the way. What I liked: Wide, non-slip steps are much easier on bare feet Easy to deploy from the water Great for pontoons, docks, and swim platforms The advertised 600 lb capacity seems realistic based on how solid the ladder feels, though I haven't tested it anywhere near that limit.
